description: Add a teammate's (or the owner's) cell to the phones that ring before Kai answers. Idempotent — a cell already listed is reported as already included. Owners and admins are also registered on the admin roster, so calling the business line from that cell reaches the admin secretary; a member only rings. The business's own forwarded-from office line is refused (forwarding_loop) because ringing it would bounce the call straight back. Requires the phone system to be set up first (set_up_phone_system). Mirrors POST /api/v1/phone-system action=add_ring_group_member.

business_id.description: Business ID (required when the token can access multiple businesses).

phone_number.description: The cell to add, US format (e.g. (908) 555-1234 or +19085551234).

role.description: member only rings; owner and admin also get admin-secretary access from this cell. Defaults to admin.
